plain_english_policy: Allocate state funds to enhance security measures at critical infrastructure sites (e.g., power plants, bridges) to counter terrorism.

effects.rationale: Direct state funding for security infrastructure constitutes government intervention in economic operations to mitigate perceived threats.
State funding implies public provision of security services, bypassing private sector reliance.
General state funding (without targeted exemptions) likely falls on broad tax bases, disproportionately affecting middle/low-income earners.

evidence_quote: "Increase state funding for additional security of critical infrastructure"
